Initial release of work-productivity-agent-browser-workflow-helper.

- Provides structured practical support for Agent Browser-style workflows on Clawhub.
- Assists users with bug fixing, setup hardening, reliability improvements, and creating adjacent skills for common productivity needs.
- Features a repeatable workflow: restate goals, plan, minimize manual steps, produce artifacts, and validate results.
- Output includes actionable templates, scripts, checklists, and decision aids optimized for local hardware use.
- Triggered by keywords and phrases related to work productivity automation, browser workflows, and agent-based tasks.
